Welcome to Agent School — lesson thirteen.
Everything so far was about a model that talks.
Now we give it a job.
Ask a chatbot: "find me a cheap flight to Dubai." It tells you how to search.
Ask an agent the same thing… and it searches, compares prices, and comes back with options.
An agent is an AI model plus three things: tools it can use, a goal to reach, and a loop to keep going until it's done.
The model is still the brain.
But now its predictions decide actions: search this, open that, check again.
An agent that can act can also act wrong.
That's why later lessons cover guardrails.
Agent equals model, tools, goal, and a loop.
Tomorrow… the four-step loop every AI agent runs.
